sentences.zh: 明确的领土。

sentences.en: A permanent population.
sentences.zh: 永久的人口。

sentences.en: A government.
sentences.zh: 政府。

sentences.en: Sealand has various government posts apart from the monarchy.
sentences.zh: 除了君主制，西兰公国还有各种政府职位。

sentences.en: Their tax lawyer is their minister of foreign affairs.
sentences.zh: 他们的税务律师担任外交大臣。

sentences.en: And the caretaker that stays out there when they're gone
sentences.zh: 而当他们离开时留守在那里的看守人，

sentences.en: is head of homeland security.
sentences.zh: 则是国土安全部部长。

sentences.en: He's the one that issues visas
sentences.zh: 他负责签发签证，

sentences.en: and stamps your passport if you visit.
sentences.zh: 如果你去访问，他还会给你的护照盖章。

sentences.en: Their legal code is pretty simple.
sentences.zh: 他们的法律体系相当简单。

sentences.en: They basically have all the same laws as England.
sentences.zh: 基本上和英国的法律一模一样。

sentences.en: Well, almost all the same laws.
sentences.zh: 嗯，几乎一模一样。

sentences.en: Unlike England, Sealand allows guns.
sentences.zh: 与英国不同，西兰公国允许持枪。

sentences.en: Prince Michael loves guns.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔亲王热爱枪支。

sentences.en: But they never really had to use them.
sentences.zh: 但他们从未真正使用过。

sentences.en: Except once.
sentences.zh: 除了那一次。

sentences.en: There aren't a lot of ways to make money on Sealand,
sentences.zh: 在西兰公国赚钱的门路不多，

sentences.en: which meant the family was always trying to come up with money-making schemes.
sentences.zh: 这意味着这家人总是想方设法搞些赚钱的计划。

sentences.en: And sometimes these schemes got a little weird.
sentences.zh: 有时这些计划显得有点古怪。

sentences.en: In 1978, Roy, Michael's dad,
sentences.zh: 1978年，迈克尔的父亲罗伊，

sentences.en: started talking to some businessmen from Germany, Austria, and Belgium.
sentences.zh: 开始与一些来自德国、奥地利和比利时的商人接触。

sentences.en: They wanted to build a leisure island around Sealand
sentences.zh: 他们想在西兰公国周围建一个休闲岛，

sentences.en: and put a casino on it.
sentences.zh: 并在上面开一家赌场。

sentences.en: And one day, Roy and his wife went to Austria
sentences.zh: 有一天，罗伊和妻子去了奥地利，

sentences.en: to talk with some funders about this deal.
sentences.zh: 与一些投资人商谈这笔交易。

sentences.en: Back at Sealand, Michael, who was 25 at the time,
sentences.zh: 在西兰公国，当时25岁的迈克尔，

sentences.en: was figuratively holding down the literal fort
sentences.zh: 正象征性地守卫着这座名副其实的堡垒，

sentences.en: when a helicopter showed up
sentences.zh: 这时一架直升机出现了，

sentences.en: and a group of men lowered themselves to the platform.
sentences.zh: 一群人降落到了平台上。

sentences.en: The first man down I recognized.
sentences.zh: 第一个下来的人我认得。

sentences.en: Michael knew some of these guys coming out of the helicopter
sentences.zh: 迈克尔认识从直升机上下来的这些人中的一些，

sentences.en: as men his dad had worked with.
sentences.zh: 他们是他父亲曾经的合作伙伴。

sentences.en: One of them was part of Sealand's government,
sentences.zh: 其中一人是西兰公国政府成员，

sentences.en: its minister of foreign affairs.
sentences.zh: 担任外交大臣。

sentences.en: A guy by the name of Alexander Achenbach.
sentences.zh: 一个叫亚历山大·阿亨巴赫的人。

sentences.en: But according to Michael,
sentences.zh: 但据迈克尔说，

sentences.en: Achenbach was trying to shut Michael's family out of the casino deal.
sentences.zh: 阿亨巴赫试图把迈克尔一家排除在赌场交易之外。

sentences.en: He was allegedly staging a coup.
sentences.zh: 他涉嫌发动政变。

sentences.en: And so he says to Michael,
sentences.zh: 于是他对迈克尔说：

sentences.en: Hey, I just met with your father,
sentences.zh: 嘿，我刚见过你父亲，

sentences.en: and he signed Sealand over to me.
sentences.zh: 他已经把西兰公国转让给我了。

sentences.en: It's mine now.
sentences.zh: 现在它是我的了。

sentences.en: And Michael in his head is like,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔心里想的是：

sentences.en: No way.
sentences.zh: 没门。

sentences.en: I don't believe you.
sentences.zh: 我才不信。

sentences.en: And I said,
sentences.zh: 我说：

sentences.en: Oh no, I think perhaps you'd better go back
sentences.zh: 哦不，我想你最好还是坐直升机回去，

sentences.en: in a helicopter and bring my father out.
sentences.zh: 把我父亲接过来吧。

sentences.en: Michael goes into the house to get everyone some drinks,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔进屋去给大家拿饮料，

sentences.en: and as he's doing this,
sentences.zh: 就在这时，

sentences.en: Michael says Achenbach and his goons slammed the front door
sentences.zh: 迈克尔说阿亨巴赫和他的打手们猛地关上大门，

sentences.en: and barricaded it,
sentences.zh: 并将其封死，

sentences.en: trapping Michael in his own home.
sentences.zh: 把迈克尔困在了自己的家里。

sentences.en: I was in there four days until I was let out.
sentences.zh: 我在里面待了四天，直到被放出来。

sentences.en: After four long days,
sentences.zh: 四天漫长的日子过后，

sentences.en: Michael's captors put him on a boat to Holland.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔的俘虏把他送上一艘去往荷兰的船。

sentences.en: Exiled in Holland,
sentences.zh: 流亡荷兰期间，

sentences.en: Michael gets in touch with his dad,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔联系上了他父亲，

sentences.en: who confirmed that of course he hadn't signed Sealand over to Achenbach.
sentences.zh: 父亲证实他当然没有把西兰公国转让给阿亨巴赫。

sentences.en: And they made a plan to take their country back.
sentences.zh: 于是他们制定了夺回国家的计划。

sentences.en: They call up a friend who has a helicopter company.
sentences.zh: 他们打电话给一位经营直升机公司的朋友。

sentences.en: We explained the situation.
sentences.zh: 我们说明了情况。

sentences.en: He said,
sentences.zh: 他说：

sentences.en: Okay, I'll do it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我干了。

sentences.en: I'll take you out there.
sentences.zh: 我送你们过去。

sentences.en: Before they take off,
sentences.zh: 起飞前，

sentences.en: they remove the doors from the helicopter
sentences.zh: 他们拆掉了直升机的舱门，

sentences.en: and tie ropes to the runners
sentences.zh: 并在起落架上系了绳子，

sentences.en: so that when they get to Sealand,
sentences.zh: 这样当他们到达西兰公国时，

sentences.en: they can slide down the ropes,
sentences.zh: 就可以顺着绳子滑下去，

sentences.en: Navy SEAL style,
sentences.zh: 像美国海军海豹突击队那样，

sentences.en: and storm the platform.
sentences.zh: 强攻平台。

sentences.en: They take off in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 他们在深夜起飞。

sentences.en: We're flying out over the North Sea
sentences.zh: 我们飞越北海，

sentences.en: with no doors and this helicopter in the dark.
sentences.zh: 在黑暗中，直升机没有舱门。

sentences.en: They slid down the ropes onto the platform of Sealand.
sentences.zh: 他们顺着绳子滑到了西兰公国的平台上。

sentences.en: We slid down ropes,
sentences.zh: 我们顺着绳子滑下去，

sentences.en: and I was the first one down.
sentences.zh: 我是第一个下去的。

sentences.en: As I hit the deck,
sentences.zh: 当我双脚着地时，

sentences.en: I could see all the Germans running out the building.
sentences.zh: 我看到所有德国人都从楼里跑了出来。

sentences.en: Everyone was shouting in German and running around.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在用德语大喊大叫，四处乱跑。

sentences.en: Michael climbed up onto the roof of the building.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔爬上了楼顶。

sentences.en: With a sawn or shotgun, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，手里拿着一把短管霰弹枪。

sentences.en: I forgot to mention that.
sentences.zh: 我忘了提这个了。

sentences.en: In case you didn't catch that,
sentences.zh: 如果你没听清的话，

sentences.en: he said he had a sawed-off shotgun.
sentences.zh: 他说他有一把短管霰弹枪。

sentences.en: And then I jumped off the roof,
sentences.zh: 然后我从屋顶跳了下去，

sentences.en: which was about 12 foot high.
sentences.zh: 大约有12英尺高。

sentences.en: He jumped off the roof,
sentences.zh: 他从屋顶跳了下来，

sentences.en: and according to Michael,
sentences.zh: 据迈克尔说，

sentences.en: the gun accidentally went off.
sentences.zh: 枪走火了。

sentences.en: Boom, it went off.
sentences.zh: 砰的一声，枪响了。

sentences.en: Everybody's hands went up in the air.
sentences.zh: 所有人都举起了双手。

sentences.en: That one shot was enough to scare the invaders into surrendering.
sentences.zh: 那一枪足以吓得入侵者投降。

sentences.en: Roy and Michael let all the non-citizens of Sealand go.
sentences.zh: 罗伊和迈克尔放走了所有非西兰公国公民。

sentences.en: But the Minister of Foreign Affairs,
sentences.zh: 但外交大臣，

sentences.en: Alexander Achenbach,
sentences.zh: 亚历山大·阿亨巴赫，

sentences.en: did not get off so easily.
sentences.zh: 没能那么轻易脱身。

sentences.en: Achenbach had betrayed the crown.
sentences.zh: 阿亨巴赫背叛了王室。

sentences.en: They charged him with treason and brought him to trial.
sentences.zh: 他们以叛国罪起诉他并对他进行了审判。

sentences.en: Well, my father was a presiding judge,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我父亲是首席法官，

sentences.en: so he kind of might have been slightly biased,
sentences.zh: 所以他可能有点偏袒，

sentences.en: but...
sentences.zh: 但是……

sentences.en: They held Achenbach prisoner
sentences.zh: 他们把阿亨巴赫关押起来，

sentences.en: until a German ambassador actually came out to Sealand
sentences.zh: 直到一位德国大使亲自来到西兰公国，

sentences.en: to negotiate for his release.
sentences.zh: 为他的释放进行谈判。

sentences.en: Eventually, they let him go,
sentences.zh: 最终，他们放了他，

sentences.en: and with that, all hostilities were ended.
sentences.zh: 至此，所有敌对行动宣告结束。

sentences.en: When the German government sent their ambassador
sentences.zh: 当德国政府派遣大使

sentences.en: out to negotiate the release of one of their citizens,
sentences.zh: 前来谈判释放其公民时，

sentences.en: this, says Michael,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔说，

sentences.en: has them entering into formal relations with Sealand,
sentences.zh: 这标志着他们与西兰公国建立了正式关系，

sentences.en: which fulfills the fourth and final criterion
sentences.zh: 这满足了成为国家的第四个也是最后一个标准。

sentences.en: for being a state.
sentences.zh: 作为一个国际法主体，国家

sentences.en: The state, as a person of international law,
sentences.zh: 应具备以下资格：

sentences.en: should possess the following qualifications.
sentences.zh: 明确的领土。

sentences.en: A defined territory.
sentences.zh: 永久的人口。

sentences.en: A permanent population.
sentences.zh: 拥有永久人口。

sentences.en: A government.
sentences.zh: 拥有政府。

sentences.en: And capacity to enter into relations with other states.
sentences.zh: 以及与他国建立关系的能力。

sentences.en: They've ticked all of the boxes.
sentences.zh: 它们满足了所有条件。

sentences.en: There's very little that you can say
sentences.zh: 你几乎找不出什么理由

sentences.en: to dissuade them from legitimacy, really.
sentences.zh: 来否定它们的合法性，真的。

sentences.en: Who are we to say that it's not a country?
sentences.zh: 我们凭什么说它不是一个国家呢？

sentences.en: That's John Ryan again,
sentences.zh: 说话的又是约翰·瑞安（John Ryan），

sentences.en: who wrote The Lonely Planet Guide to Micronations.
sentences.zh: 他撰写了《孤独星球微型国家指南》。

sentences.en: While he might concede that Sealand fulfills the criteria
sentences.zh: 虽然他或许会承认西兰公国满足了

sentences.en: for being a real state,
sentences.zh: 作为一个真正国家的标准，

sentences.en: most experts do not.
sentences.zh: 但大多数专家并不这么认为。

sentences.en: Oh, definitely, no.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对不是。

sentences.en: It is not a state, no.
sentences.zh: 它不是一个国家，真的不是。

sentences.en: That is Jure Vidmar.
sentences.zh: 这位是尤雷·维德马（Jure Vidmar）。

sentences.en: Jure is a fellow at Oxford
sentences.zh: 尤雷是牛津大学的研究员，

sentences.en: and an expert in international law.
sentences.zh: 也是国际法专家。

sentences.en: He's thought a lot about what makes a state the state.
sentences.zh: 他深入思考过究竟是什么让一个国家成为国家。

sentences.en: Sealand is just an abandoned platform.
sentences.zh: 西兰公国只是一个废弃的平台。

sentences.en: It is not really a viable place to live.
sentences.zh: 它并不是一个真正适宜居住的地方。

sentences.en: And by explaining that incident as relations with another state,
sentences.zh: 把那次事件解释为与另一个国家的关系，

sentences.en: I mean, they're trying to fit their case within the convention.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们正试图让自己的案例符合公约。

sentences.en: But I mean, it's a joke that was taken actually quite far.
sentences.zh: 但说实话，这只是一个被玩得有点过火的玩笑。

sentences.en: Which doesn't mean the Montevideo convention is worthless.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着《蒙得维的亚公约》毫无价值。

sentences.en: It's just not complete.
sentences.zh: 它只是不够完善。

sentences.en: What really matters, Jure says, is recognition.
sentences.zh: 尤雷说，真正重要的是承认。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, it is political.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这是一个政治问题。

sentences.en: If, say, 190 states of this world recognized Sealand
sentences.zh: 如果说，世界上有190个国家承认西兰公国

sentences.en: as being an independent state,
sentences.zh: 是一个独立国家，

sentences.en: I think there would be no doubt that it was an independent state.
sentences.zh: 我想毫无疑问它就是一个独立国家。

sentences.en: But this would, of course, never happen.
sentences.zh: 但这当然永远不会发生。

sentences.en: There are a lot of places that meet the Montevideo criteria
sentences.zh: 有很多地方符合《蒙得维的亚公约》的标准，

sentences.en: that, rightly or wrongly, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但无论对错，美国

sentences.en: does not consider nations.
sentences.zh: 并不认为它们是国家。

sentences.en: Palestine, for example, is recognized by 135 other countries,
sentences.zh: 例如，巴勒斯坦得到了135个国家的承认，

sentences.en: but not by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但美国并不承认。

sentences.en: And then there's Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 还有台湾。

sentences.en: Taiwan meets all the criteria.
sentences.zh: 台湾满足所有标准。

sentences.en: It has a permanent population, a government, a defined territory,
sentences.zh: 它有永久人口、政府、明确的领土，

sentences.en: and they are able to enter into diplomatic relations with other countries.
sentences.zh: 并且能够与其他国家建立外交关系。

sentences.en: Taiwan is currently recognized by 22 countries,
sentences.zh: 目前有22个国家承认台湾，

sentences.en: mostly small countries like Tuvalu and Burkina Faso.
sentences.zh: 大多是像图瓦卢和布基纳法索这样的小国。

sentences.en: But China still considers Taiwan to be a Chinese province.
sentences.zh: 但中国仍然认为台湾是中国的一个省。

sentences.en: And because we don't want to piss off China,
sentences.zh: 因为我们不想惹恼中国，

sentences.en: we also don't recognize Taiwan as a state.
sentences.zh: 所以我们也不承认台湾是一个国家。

sentences.en: Although the U.S.
sentences.zh: 尽管美国

sentences.en: government does send ambassadors to Taiwan,
sentences.zh: 政府确实会向台湾派遣大使，

sentences.en: we just technically make the ambassadors resign when we send them,
sentences.zh: 但我们只是在派遣时让大使辞职，

sentences.en: and then we reinstate them when they're transferred to another poSt.
sentences.zh: 等他们调任其他职位时再恢复其身份。

sentences.en: So if China says anything about it, we can be like,
sentences.zh: 所以如果中国对此提出异议，我们可以说，

sentences.en: Ambassador, what ambassador?
sentences.zh: 大使？什么大使？

sentences.en: So maybe statehood's more a matter of degrees.
sentences.zh: 所以也许国家地位更多是一个程度问题。

sentences.en: Some states are recognized by 120 legitimate countries,
sentences.zh: 有些国家得到120个合法国家的承认，

sentences.en: whereas others are only recognized by 5 or 10 countries.
sentences.zh: 而另一些国家只得到5或10个国家的承认。

sentences.en: As of this moment, no one formally recognizes Sealand as a state,
sentences.zh: 截至目前，没有任何国家正式承认西兰公国是一个国家，

sentences.en: not even Tuvalu or Burkina Faso.
sentences.zh: 连图瓦卢或布基纳法索都没有。

sentences.en: As for the population of Sealand,
sentences.zh: 至于西兰公国的人口，

sentences.en: as Roy Bates, the founder, got older,
sentences.zh: 随着创始人罗伊·贝茨（Roy Bates）年事渐高，

sentences.en: he found it easier to live on the mainland.
sentences.zh: 他发现住在内陆更方便。

sentences.en: He died in Essex in England in 2012.
sentences.zh: 他于2012年在英国埃塞克斯去世。

sentences.en: Michael got married, and his new wife, you can't blame her,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔结婚了，他的新婚妻子——你不能怪她——

sentences.en: didn't like life out on the platform,
sentences.zh: 不喜欢住在平台上的生活，

sentences.en: so he moved to mainland England too.
sentences.zh: 所以他也搬到了英国本土。

sentences.en: These days, it's just the head of Homeland Security
sentences.zh: 如今，只有国土安全部部长

sentences.en: that lives out on the platform.
sentences.zh: 住在那个平台上。

sentences.en: But Prince Michael likes the idea that it's there,
sentences.zh: 但迈克尔亲王喜欢它在那里存在的感觉，

sentences.en: if he ever wants to move back.
sentences.zh: 万一他哪天想搬回去住呢。

sentences.en: Sealand will likely never have true sovereignty.
sentences.zh: 西兰公国可能永远不会拥有真正的主权。

sentences.en: But at the same time, England has never formally reclaimed it.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，英国也从未正式收回它。

sentences.en: Probably because doing so would be harder
sentences.zh: 可能是因为这样做比

sentences.en: than just letting it keep being what it is.
sentences.zh: 任由它保持现状要麻烦得多。

sentences.en: So even though their little windswept platform on the sea
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管他们那座海面上风吹雨打的小平台

sentences.en: might not be much,
sentences.zh: 可能算不上什么，

sentences.en: it is theirs.
sentences.zh: 但它是属于他们的。

sentences.en: And their flag still flies.
sentences.zh: 而且他们的旗帜依然飘扬。

sentences.en: At least for now.
sentences.zh: 至少目前如此。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Julia DeWitt and Katie Mengel
sentences.zh: 本周的《99% Invisible》由朱莉娅·德威特（Julia DeWitt）和凯蒂·门格尔（Katie Mengel）制作，

sentences.en: with Sam Greenspan, Avery Truffleman, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 参与制作的还有萨姆·格林斯潘（Sam Greenspan）、艾弗里·特鲁夫曼（Avery Truffleman）以及我，罗曼·马尔斯（Roman Mars）。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 KALW San Francisco
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山91.7 KALW电台的一个项目，

sentences.en: and produced out of the offices of ArcSign,
sentences.zh: 在ArcSign的办公室制作，

sentences.en: Oakland's premier architecture and interiors firm
sentences.zh: 这是奥克兰首屈一指的建筑与室内设计公司，

sentences.en: in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 位于加利福尼亚州美丽的奥克兰市中心。
